fixtures.generator: stdlib hash-derived deterministic streams; no corpus or asset

method.endpoint_policy: detections at sequence endpoints are counted but not repaired
method.frame_semantics: 160-sample frames; output frame p covers source payload positions [p,p+160); p starts at -3 and advances by 160; valid source intervals are clipped to accepted content and padding is flagged
method.repair: simultaneous midpoint interpolation of detected interior samples
method.source_coordinate_map: sample index i -> i*62500 ns in one monotonic domain

blockers: No natural click, breath, consonant or disfluency labels; synthetic square pulses only.
No listening test or authorized human preservation score; envelope/SI-SDR proxies only.
No real weights, downloads, licensed runtime or model asset in this package.
No target-device, paced-callback, CPU/deadline, memory or availability measurement; the pinned research RTF 0.000290 is source-reported, not reproduced here.
No registered SDK provider, descriptor, ABI, default or installed-archive consumer run.
No STOI or intelligibility measurement; no pystoi dependency installed.
No release qualification, benchmark bundle or board transition; independent review required.
reopen_conditions: Agree click/breath target definitions, rate margins, preservation thresholds, pitch/transient controls and deadline budget before qualification.
Collect rights-cleared natural events and speech-like material with independent labels and listener or authorized quality scores.
Build the exact native provider through public registration, verify an installed consumer and compare frame-by-frame on a frozen cohort.
Run the paced target profile with buffering/fill/flush and resource evidence.
Pass independent review and separate contract/release work before any default promotion.

non_claims: No real weights, model, download or licensed runtime is included.
No corpus, recorded speech, natural click or breath event was used.
No listening, STOI, intelligibility or target-speaker quality result is claimed.
No target-device pacing, CPU, deadline, memory, availability or fill/flush result.
No source-reported RTF is reproduced as local timing evidence.
No public API/ABI, descriptor registry, default, installed v0 behavior or release.
